userStories.title: Sample story: add request logging middleware
acceptanceCriteria: Create `internal/middleware/logging.go` exporting `NewLoggingMiddleware(logger)` that wraps HTTP handlers and logs method, path, status, and duration.
Register the middleware in `cmd/api/main.go` so every endpoint is covered.
Add tests proving the middleware logs status codes for both success and failure paths.
Document the new middleware and log format in `README.md`.
Run `go test ./...` and record the result in `scripts/ralph/progress.txt`.
